text: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
reflection: Worry asks you to carry tomorrow alone. Prayer hands it back to the One who already holds it.

text: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
reflection: You don't have to carry your worries alone. God cares for you and invites you to give Him everything that feels heavy.

text: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
reflection: Today has enough grace for today. Let tomorrow wait until it arrives.

text: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
reflection: Fear shrinks when you remember who stands beside you. You are held, helped and upheld.

text: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.
reflection: His peace doesn't depend on calm circumstances. It is a gift you can receive even in the storm.

text: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
reflection: Trust isn't the absence of fear. It's choosing where to turn when fear comes.

text: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
reflection: Fear is not your inheritance. Power, love and a steady mind are already yours.

text: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
reflection: Stillness is not doing nothing. It is resting in the truth that God is in control.

text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
reflection: The invitation is simple: come as you are, tired and heavy, and receive rest.

text: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
reflection: What feels too heavy for you is never too heavy for Him. Let Him sustain you today.

text: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
reflection: Where your mind rests, your heart follows. Fix your thoughts on Him and find peace.

text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
reflection: When your thoughts race, His comfort meets you right in the middle of them.

text: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
reflection: Your pain doesn't push God away. He draws closest when your heart is breaking.

text: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
reflection: Healing may be slow, but it is certain. He tends every wound with care.

text: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.
reflection: Every tear is seen, and one day every tear will be wiped away. Sorrow does not have the last word.

text: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
reflection: Night feels long, but it always ends. Morning and joy are on their way.

text: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
reflection: Grief is not a sign of weak faith. It is a place where God's comfort is promised.

text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.
reflection: It's okay to be honest about a heavy heart, and then to speak hope to it.

text: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
reflection: Even when the road is unclear, God's thoughts toward you are good, and your story has a hopeful end.

text: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
reflection: Hope isn't something you have to manufacture. The God of hope fills you until it overflows.

text: It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.
reflection: Yesterday's failures don't define today. His mercy is fresh every single morning.

text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
reflection: Not everything is good, but God is weaving even the hard things into something good.

text: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
reflection: Faith holds on to what God has promised, even before you can see it.

text: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
reflection: Waiting on God isn't wasted time. It's where tired hearts are renewed.

text: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
reflection: Your strength may run out, but His never does. Lean on Him for what's in front of you.

text: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
reflection: Courage comes from company. Wherever you go today, you do not go alone.

text: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness.
reflection: Your weakness is not a barrier to God. It's the very place His strength shows up.

text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
reflection: Help isn't far off or delayed. In trouble, God is present right now.

text: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help. My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
reflection: Look up. The One who made the mountains is the One who helps you.

text: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
reflection: God is already ahead of you on the road you're afraid to walk.

text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
reflection: You don't need the whole map. Trust Him with the next step, and He will direct the path.

text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
reflection: A shepherd leads, protects and provides. You are cared for, even when you feel lost.

text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
reflection: A lamp lights the next few steps, not the whole journey. That's enough to keep walking.

text: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.
reflection: When you don't know which way to turn, listen. God still guides those who seek Him.

text: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
reflection: Feeling lost doesn't put you out of reach. You are exactly who Jesus came looking for.

text: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
reflection: God doesn't just point the way. He walks with you and teaches you as you go.

text: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
reflection: Gratitude doesn't wait for perfect days. It finds God's goodness in every one.

text: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
reflection: His goodness isn't seasonal. His mercy lasts forever, and that's always worth thanks.

text: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
reflection: Today is a gift, made on purpose. Receive it with gladness.

text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
reflection: Every good thing in your life traces back to a generous Father who never changes.

text: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
reflection: Peace and thankfulness grow together. Let both settle into your heart today.

text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
reflection: Thanksgiving is the doorway into God's presence. Start with thanks and see where it leads.

text: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
reflection: Joy in the Lord doesn't depend on circumstances. It's rooted in who He is.

text: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
reflection: The fullest joy isn't found in what you have, but in whose presence you're in.

text: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
reflection: Jesus wants your joy to be full, not partial or passing, but lasting.

text: The LORD thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.
reflection: Imagine it: God rejoices over you with singing. You are deeply delighted in.

text: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
reflection: Take a moment to remember what God has already done. Gladness follows remembering.

text: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
reflection: You can rest and sleep in total peace, knowing God watches over every breath.

text: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD , only makest me dwell in safety.
reflection: Lay down in quiet safety; God alone makes you dwell without fear.

text: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
reflection: The Lord is an unshakeable refuge for the oppressed in times of trouble.

text: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
reflection: He gently leads you beside quiet waters, granting true rest to your weary soul.

text: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
reflection: God is your hiding place; He preserves you from trouble and surrounds you with songs of deliverance.

text: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
reflection: The righteous cry, and the Lord hears, delivering them out of all their troubles.

text: Commit thy way unto the LORD ; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
reflection: Commit your way unto the Lord; trust also in Him, and He shall bring it to pass.

text: Rest in the LORD , and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
reflection: Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for Him without fret or worry over worldly schemes.

text: Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until these calamities be overpast.
reflection: Take refuge in the shadow of God's wings until life's fierce storms pass by.

text: Trust in him at all times; ye people, pour out your heart before him: God is a refuge for us. Selah.
reflection: Pour out your heart before Him at all times; God is an open refuge for us.

text: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
reflection: He that dwells in the secret place of the Most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

text: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
reflection: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the raging waves thereof are still.

text: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.
reflection: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend or stumble them.

text: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
reflection: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.

text: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
reflection: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.

text: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.
reflection: He shall feed His flock like a shepherd: He shall gather the lambs with His arm, and carry them in His bosom.

text: But now thus saith the LORD that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
reflection: Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.

text: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
reflection: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.

text: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
reflection: Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.

text: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
reflection: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.

text: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
reflection: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

text: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
reflection: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for He hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.

text: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
reflection: God turns your mourning into dancing, removing your sackcloth and clothing you with gladness.

text: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
reflection: The meek shall inherit the earth and delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

text: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
reflection: Restore unto me the joy of Thy salvation, and uphold me with Thy free spirit.

text: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
reflection: Because God has been your help, rejoice beneath the shadow of His loving wings.

text: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
reflection: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy and sing songs of harvest.

text: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
reflection: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: peace of mind brings healing to the whole body.

text: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
reflection: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.

text: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
reflection: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.

text: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
reflection: The work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.

text: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the LORD , that he might be glorified.
reflection: To give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness.

text: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
reflection: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

text: And ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.
reflection: Ye now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man taketh from you.

text: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.
reflection: The kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.

text: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.
reflection: Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.

text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
reflection: The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

text: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
reflection: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.

text: But thou, O LORD , art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.
reflection: The Lord is your shield and the lifter of your head, transforming your trial into triumph.

text: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD , hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
reflection: Those who know God's name put their trust in Him, for He has never forsaken those who seek Him.

text: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
reflection: The Lord is your rock, your fortress, and your deliverer in whom you can hide safely.

text: For thou wilt light my candle: the LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.
reflection: God lights your candle in the dark; He turns every shadow into radiant day.

text: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
reflection: Even through the darkest valley, fear no evil; His rod and staff comfort you always.

text: The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the LORD is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
reflection: The Lord is your light and salvation; there is no one and nothing you need to fear.

text: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.
reflection: The Lord will give strength unto His people and bless them with everlasting peace.

text: I sought the LORD , and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
reflection: Seek the Lord and He will hear you, delivering your heart from all debilitating fears.

text: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
reflection: The angel of the Lord encamps round about those who fear Him and delivers them.

text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.
reflection: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the Lord delivers them out of them all.

text: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth him with his hand.
reflection: Though you may stumble, you will not fall headlong, for the Lord upholds you with His hand.

text: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD : he is their strength in the time of trouble.
reflection: The salvation of the righteous is of the Lord; He is their strength in times of trouble.

text: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
reflection: He lifts you out of the miry pit and sets your feet firmly upon a solid rock.

text: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.
reflection: As the deer pants for streams of water, so your soul pants thirstily for God.

text: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
reflection: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth be removed and the mountains shake.

text: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
reflection: When your heart is overwhelmed, pray to be led to the Rock that is higher than you.

text: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.
reflection: God has been a trusted shelter and a strong tower of defense against every foe.

text: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.
reflection: Truly my soul waits upon God in silence; from Him alone comes my salvation.

text: My flesh and my heart faileth: but God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
reflection: My flesh and heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

text: I will say of the LORD , He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
reflection: Say of the Lord: He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in Him will I trust.

text: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.
reflection: He shall cover you with His feathers; under His wings you shall trust; His truth is your shield.

text: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
reflection: He shall give His angels charge over you, to keep and guard you in all your ways.

text: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
reflection: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases and restores your soul.

text: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD .
reflection: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the Lord.

text: The LORD is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
reflection: The Lord is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?

text: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
reflection: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy unfailing word.

text: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
reflection: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: He that keepeth thee will not slumber.

text: The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.
reflection: The Lord is thy keeper: the Lord is thy shade upon thy right hand.

text: In the day when I cried thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
reflection: In the day when I cried Thou answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.

text: O LORD , thou hast searched me, and known me .
reflection: O Lord, Thou hast searched me, and known me; You know every secret place of my heart.

text: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
reflection: The Lord upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.

text: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
reflection: The Lord is nigh unto all them that call upon Him, to all that call upon Him in truth.

text: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
reflection: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

text: For the LORD shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.
reflection: For the Lord shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.

text: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
reflection: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.

text: In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
reflection: In the fear of the Lord is strong confidence: and His children shall have a place of refuge.

text: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
reflection: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

text: Commit thy works unto the LORD , and thy thoughts shall be established.
reflection: Commit thy works unto the Lord, and thy thoughts shall be established.

text: When a man’s ways please the LORD , he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
reflection: When a man's ways please the Lord, He maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.

text: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
reflection: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.

text: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
reflection: The name of the Lord is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

text: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.
reflection: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the Lord shall be safe.

text: For thus saith the Lord GOD , the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.
reflection: In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength.

text: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompence; he will come and save you.
reflection: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come and save you.

text: For I the LORD thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
reflection: For I the Lord thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.

text: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
reflection: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee.

text: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD , and their righteousness is of me, saith the LORD .
reflection: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; this is the heritage of the servants of the Lord.

text: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD .
reflection: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the Lord.

text: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
reflection: The Lord shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones.

text: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
reflection: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the Lord thy God, He it is that doth go with thee; He will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

text: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them .
reflection: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms.

text: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:
reflection: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven.

text: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
reflection: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.

text: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
reflection: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

text: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
reflection: Seek ye first the kingdom of God, and His righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

text: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
reflection: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.

text: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
reflection: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

text: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
reflection: Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.

text: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.
reflection: To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace.

text: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
reflection: Whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but it shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

text: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
reflection: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.

text: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
reflection: The Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us.

text: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
reflection: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?

text: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
reflection: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.

text: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.

text: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble, by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God.

text: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
reflection: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;

text: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.

text: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
reflection: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

text: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
reflection: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

text: Pray without ceasing.
reflection: Pray without ceasing.

text: But the Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
reflection: The Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.

text: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.
reflection: Now the Lord of peace Himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.

text: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

text: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.

text: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
reflection: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and He shall lift you up.

text: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time:
reflection: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that He may exalt you in due time:

text: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
reflection: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is He that is in you, than he that is in the world.

text: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
reflection: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.

text: But his delight is in the law of the LORD ; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
reflection: Delight in God's word nourishes your mind and guides your daily decisions with clarity.

text: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
reflection: Rejoice under the shelter of God's wings; His defense surrounding you is sure.

text: One thing have I desired of the LORD , that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the LORD , and to enquire in his temple.
reflection: Seek above all else to behold the beauty of the Lord and dwell in His holy temple.

text: How excellent is thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.
reflection: How excellent is God's lovingkindness! Children of men find shelter under His wings.

text: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.
reflection: With God is the fountain of life, and in His light we clearly see light.

text: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
reflection: A broken and contrite heart, O God, You will not despise; grace meets your humility.

text: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
reflection: Seek God early; in a dry and thirsty land, His love satisfies your innermost being.

text: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.
reflection: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens and carries our cares.

text: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
reflection: The Lord is full of compassion, gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.

text: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD , all ye lands.
reflection: Make a joyful noise unto the Lord, all ye lands, and celebrate His sovereign grace.

text: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the LORD pitieth them that fear him.
reflection: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the Lord pitieth and cares for them that fear Him.

text: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
reflection: For He satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.

text: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.
reflection: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the Lord hath dealt bountifully with thee.

text: The LORD is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.
reflection: The Lord is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

text: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.
reflection: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.

text: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
reflection: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

text: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
reflection: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

text: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
reflection: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.

text: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
reflection: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.

text: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the LORD JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
reflection: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the Lord JEHOVAH is my strength and my song.

text: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.
reflection: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee.

text: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
reflection: He was wounded for our transgressions, He was bruised for our iniquities: with His stripes we are healed.

text: The LORD hath appeared of old unto me, saying , Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.
reflection: The Lord hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.

text: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls:
reflection: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; yet I will rejoice in the Lord.

text: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
reflection: The joy of the Lord is your strength; let His gladness fill and restore your heart.

text: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
reflection: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.

text: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?
reflection: Behold the fowls of the air: your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?

text: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.
reflection: If the Son therefore shall make you free, ye shall be free indeed.

text: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.
reflection: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.

text: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
reflection: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him that loved us.

text: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
reflection: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer.

text: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;
reflection: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort.

text: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is , there is liberty.
reflection: Now the Lord is that Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

text: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
reflection: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, honest, just, pure, lovely, of good report; think on these things.

text: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.
reflection: I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.

text: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.
reflection: Comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.

text: Rejoice evermore.
reflection: Rejoice evermore.

text: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
reflection: Godliness with contentment is great gain.

text: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
reflection: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:

text: My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;
reflection: Count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations; knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.

text: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
reflection: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see Him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:

text: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.
reflection: We have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.

text: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
reflection: Whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.

text: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.
reflection: Marvel at the majesty of the Creator whose glory fills the earth and stars.

text: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!
reflection: All creation echoes the excellent name of the Lord who cares deeply for you.

text: I will praise thee , O LORD , with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
reflection: Praise God with your whole heart; recounting His wondrous works drives out despair.

text: I have set the LORD always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
reflection: Keep the Lord continually before you; with Him at your right hand, you shall not be shaken.

text: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth: my flesh also shall rest in hope.
reflection: A glad heart and rejoicing soul rest secure in the constant goodness of God.

text: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.
reflection: It is God who girds you with strength and makes your way straight and secure.

text: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
reflection: The heavens declare the glory of God, reminding you of the majesty behind your life.

text: The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.
reflection: God's law restores the soul, and His testimony makes simple hearts wise.

text: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the LORD our God.
reflection: While the world trusts in earthly power, our confidence rests in the holy name of the Lord.

text: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
reflection: He restores your soul and leads you down right paths for His name's sake.

text: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
reflection: God prepares a table of abundant blessing for you, overflowing your cup with grace.

text: Shew me thy ways, O LORD ; teach me thy paths.
reflection: Ask the Lord to reveal His ways; He faithfully teaches paths of truth to willing hearts.

text: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.
reflection: The meek and humble are guided in judgment, gently instructed in the ways of God.

text: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.
reflection: Give thanks unto God forever; your heart cannot stay silent in the light of His grace.

text: I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
reflection: Bless the Lord at all times; let His praise continually be on your lips.

text: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.
reflection: Magnify the Lord together and exalt His name in holy unity and fellowship.

text: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD : and he delighteth in his way.
reflection: The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord, and He delights in his journey.

text: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it , and fear, and shall trust in the LORD .
reflection: He puts a new song in your mouth, a hymn of praise unto our God.

text: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.
reflection: Sing aloud of God's mercy in the morning; He has been your fortress and defense.

text: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
reflection: In God is my salvation and glory; the rock of my strength and refuge is in God.

text: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.
reflection: Because Your lovingkindness is better than life itself, my lips shall praise You.

text: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
reflection: Sing forth the honour of His name; make His praise glorious throughout the earth.

text: Teach me thy way, O LORD ; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.
reflection: Teach me Thy way, O Lord; unite my heart to reverence and honor Thy name.

text: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
reflection: Teach us to number our days that we may apply our hearts unto true wisdom.

text: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
reflection: Satisfy us early with Thy mercy, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

text: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD , and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:
reflection: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the Lord, and to sing praises unto Thy name.

text: O come, let us sing unto the LORD : let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
reflection: O come, let us sing unto the Lord; let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

text: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD , all the earth.
reflection: O sing unto the Lord a new song; sing unto the Lord, all the earth.

text: O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
reflection: Sing unto the Lord a new song, for He hath done marvellous and wonder-filled things.

text: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
reflection: Serve the Lord with gladness; come before His presence with singing and joy.

text: Bless the LORD , O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
reflection: Bless the Lord, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless His holy name.

text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.
reflection: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do His commandments.

text: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
reflection: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

text: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
reflection: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

text: My help cometh from the LORD , which made heaven and earth.
reflection: My help cometh from the Lord, which made heaven and earth.

text: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.
reflection: Even there shall Thy hand lead me, and Thy right hand shall hold me.

text: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
reflection: I will praise Thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are Thy works.

text: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.
reflection: Great is our Lord, and of great power: His understanding is infinite.

text: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD . Praise ye the LORD .
reflection: Let every thing that hath breath praise the Lord. Praise ye the Lord.

text: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
reflection: In all thy ways acknowledge Him, and He shall direct thy paths with wisdom and light.

text: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD , and depart from evil.
reflection: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the Lord, and depart from evil.

text: The blessing of the LORD , it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
reflection: The blessing of the Lord, it maketh rich, and He addeth no sorrow with it.

text: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
reflection: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

text: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.
reflection: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.

text: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it !
reflection: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!

text: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
reflection: A man's heart deviseth his way: but the Lord directeth his steps.

text: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
reflection: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!

text: Man’s goings are of the LORD ; how can a man then understand his own way?
reflection: Man's goings are of the Lord; how can a man then understand his own way?

text: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
reflection: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.

text: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man’s friend by hearty counsel.

text: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.

text: Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.

text: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.
reflection: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.

reflection: Ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth into singing.

reflection: I will greatly rejoice in the Lord, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for He hath clothed me with the garments of salvation.

reflection: Yet I will rejoice in the Lord, I will joy in the God of my salvation.

reflection: Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.

reflection: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over.

reflection: I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

reflection: I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.

reflection: As many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.

reflection: Present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.

reflection: Let all your things be done with charity.

reflection: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of His might.
