reflection: It is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of His good pleasure.

text: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:
reflection: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in Him:

text: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
reflection: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

text: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
reflection: Above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

text: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
reflection: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

text: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
reflection: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called.

text: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
reflection: The word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword.

text: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
reflection: Let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:

text: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
reflection: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

text: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
reflection: Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

text: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
reflection: The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.

text: But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
reflection: Ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of Him who hath called you out of darkness into His marvellous light:

text: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
reflection: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God:

text: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
reflection: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.

text: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
reflection: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.

text: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O LORD , my strength, and my redeemer.
reflection: May the words of your mouth and the meditation of your heart be pleasing to your Redeemer.

text: The earth is the LORD’s , and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
reflection: The earth and everything in it belongs to God; you are held within His vast design.

text: I had fainted , unless I had believed to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
reflection: Hold on in faith; you will truly see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.

text: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
reflection: The Lord is your strength and shield; your heart can trust Him and sing with praise.

text: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD .
reflection: The earth is full of the lovingkindness and unfailing goodness of the Lord.

text: Behold, the eye of the LORD is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;
reflection: The eye of the Lord is upon those that fear Him, upon those that hope in His steadfast mercy.

text: I waited patiently for the LORD ; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
reflection: Wait patiently for the Lord; He inclines His ear and hears your heartfelt cry.

text: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.
reflection: Why cast down, O soul? Hope in God, for you shall yet praise Him for His saving presence.

text: Yet the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.
reflection: The Lord commands His lovingkindness in the daytime, and His song is with you in the night.

text: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.
reflection: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and give praise.

text: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.
reflection: Wait only upon God, my soul; for my expectation and confident hope are from Him.

text: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
reflection: God crowns the year with His goodness, and His paths drop abundance and blessing.

text: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.
reflection: Blessed be God, who has not turned away our prayer nor His mercy from us.

text: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,
reflection: To show forth Thy lovingkindness in the morning, and Thy faithfulness every night.

text: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
reflection: O come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the Lord our Maker.

text: Know ye that the LORD he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
reflection: Know that the Lord He is God; it is He that made us, and we are the sheep of His pasture.

text: Bless the LORD , O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
reflection: Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all His gracious benefits toward you.

text: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
reflection: The Lord is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in everlasting mercy.

text: I love the LORD , because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.
reflection: I love the Lord, because He hath heard my voice and my heartfelt supplications.

text: O give thanks unto the LORD ; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.
reflection: O give thanks unto the Lord; for He is good: because His mercy endureth for ever.

text: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.
reflection: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened and revived me.

text: I wait for the LORD , my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.
reflection: I wait for the Lord, my soul doth wait, and in His word do I place my confident hope.

text: O give thanks unto the LORD ; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
reflection: O give thanks unto the Lord; for He is good: for His mercy endureth for ever.

text: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
reflection: The Lord is good to all: and His tender mercies are over all His works.

text: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
reflection: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart.

text: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
reflection: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.

text: By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches, and honour, and life.
reflection: By humility and the fear of the Lord are riches, and honour, and life.

text: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
reflection: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

text: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the LORD , she shall be praised.
reflection: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the Lord, she shall be praised.

text: O LORD , thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.
reflection: O Lord, Thou art my God; I will exalt Thee, I will praise Thy name; for Thou hast done wonderful things.

text: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.
reflection: Can a woman forget her sucking child? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.

text: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the LORD that hath mercy on thee.
reflection: The mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee.

text: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me; because the LORD hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
reflection: The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me; He hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives.

text: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.
reflection: Then shall ye call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you.

text: The LORD is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.
reflection: The Lord is good unto them that wait for Him, to the soul that seeketh Him.

text: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD .
reflection: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the Lord.

text: Therefore I will look unto the LORD ; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.
reflection: Therefore I will look unto the Lord; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.

text: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:
reflection: For I know that my Redeemer liveth, and that He shall stand at the latter day upon the earth.

text: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
reflection: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

text: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
reflection: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.

text: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.
reflection: Where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

text: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
reflection: Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength.

text: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,
reflection: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us.

text: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
reflection: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

text: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
reflection: The light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.

text: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
reflection: Of His fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.

text: And I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.
reflection: I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand.

text: Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:
reflection: I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live.

text: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
reflection: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.

text: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
reflection: Being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.

text: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
reflection: Hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.

text: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
reflection: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

text: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
reflection: I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

text: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,
reflection: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,

text: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
reflection: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

text: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
reflection: Our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;

text: And God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things , may abound to every good work:
reflection: God is able to make all grace abound toward you; that ye, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work.

text: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.
reflection: Thanks be unto God for His unspeakable gift.

text: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,
reflection: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,

text: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
reflection: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;

text: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
reflection: Rooted and built up in Him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.

text: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
reflection: Whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by Him.

text: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
reflection: Whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

text: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
reflection: The Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto His heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever.

text: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;
reflection: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;

text: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:
reflection: His divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of Him that hath called us to glory and virtue:

text: We love him, because he first loved us.
reflection: We love Him, because He first loved us.

text: For the Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.
reflection: The Lamb which is in the midst of the throne shall feed them, and shall lead them unto living fountains of waters: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.

text: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
reflection: Lift up your heads and welcome the King of glory into every corner of your life.

text: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
reflection: Our heart rejoices in Him because we have trusted in His holy name.

text: Delight thyself also in the LORD ; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
reflection: Delight yourself in the Lord, and He will give you the deepest desires of your heart.

text: O LORD of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.
reflection: O Lord of hosts, blessed is the person that trusts wholeheartedly in You.

text: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD his God:
reflection: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the Lord his God.

text: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD , happy is he.
reflection: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the Lord, happy is he.

text: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
reflection: Unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: His name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The Prince of Peace.

text: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
reflection: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee.

text: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.
reflection: Unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in His wings.

text: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
reflection: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

text: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.
reflection: Ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

text: But as it is written, Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love him.
reflection: Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which God hath prepared for them that love Him.

text: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
reflection: If any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
reflection: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to His abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope.

text: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.
reflection: Walking in God's counsel protects your steps and sets you on a path of enduring blessing.

text: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
reflection: Rooted in God's living truth, you will flourish and yield fruit in every season.

text: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD ; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.
reflection: Begin each morning by laying your prayers before Him, watching in expectant faith.

text: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.
reflection: God's way is flawless and His word is tested; He is a buckler to all who trust in Him.

text: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.
reflection: Trust God with your deepest desires; He fulfills counsel born of faith in His will.

text: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.
reflection: Wait upon God as your Savior, allowing His truth to guide your steps all day long.

text: All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
reflection: All the paths of the Lord are mercy and truth for those who keep His covenant.

text: The secret of the LORD is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.
reflection: The secret of the Lord is with those who fear Him, and He reveals His promises to them.

text: Wait on the LORD : be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD .
reflection: Wait on the Lord and be of good courage; He will strengthen your heart.

text: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD .
reflection: Be of good courage, and He shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the Lord.

text: For the word of the LORD is right; and all his works are done in truth.
reflection: The word of the Lord is right and true, and all His works are done in faithfulness.

text: Our soul waiteth for the LORD : he is our help and our shield.
reflection: Our soul waits for the Lord; He is our dependable help and protective shield.

text: Let thy mercy, O LORD , be upon us, according as we hope in thee.
reflection: Let Your mercy be upon us, O Lord, according as we place our total hope in You.

text: Trust in the LORD , and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
reflection: Trust in the Lord and do good; dwell in the land and feed on His faithfulness.

text: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
reflection: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.

text: For thou art my hope, O Lord GOD : thou art my trust from my youth.
reflection: For You are my hope, O Lord God; You have been my trust since my youth.

text: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
reflection: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.

text: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
reflection: The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

text: The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD , endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
reflection: The Lord will perfect that which concerneth me: Thy mercy, O Lord, endureth for ever.

text: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
reflection: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

text: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.
reflection: Cause me to hear Thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in Thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk.

text: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
reflection: The path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.

text: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.
reflection: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.

text: There are many devices in a man’s heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD , that shall stand.
reflection: There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the Lord, that shall stand.

text: For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off.
reflection: For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off.

text: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
reflection: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: God restores you after every stumble.

text: Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH is everlasting strength:
reflection: Trust ye in the Lord for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH is everlasting strength.

text: And therefore will the LORD wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for the LORD is a God of judgment: blessed are all they that wait for him.
reflection: Therefore will the Lord wait, that He may be gracious unto you: blessed are all they that wait for Him.

text: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
reflection: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.

text: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.
reflection: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.

text: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
reflection: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness.

text: Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:
reflection: Seek ye the Lord while He may be found, call ye upon Him while He is near.

text: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
reflection: As the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

text: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the LORD , and whose hope the LORD is.
reflection: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the Lord, and whose hope the Lord is.

text: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreadeth out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat cometh, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
reflection: He shall be as a tree planted by the waters; his leaf shall be green, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.

text: And ye shall seek me, and find me , when ye shall search for me with all your heart.
reflection: And ye shall seek me, and find me, when ye shall search for me with all your heart.

text: Ah Lord GOD ! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee:
reflection: Ah Lord God! behold, Thou hast made the heaven and the earth by Thy great power: there is nothing too hard for Thee.

text: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.
reflection: Call unto me, and I will answer thee, and shew thee great and mighty things, which thou knowest not.

text: The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
reflection: The Lord is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in Him.

text: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the LORD shall be a light unto me.
reflection: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the Lord shall be a light unto me.

text: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.
reflection: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: trust His timing across every chapter.

text: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
reflection: He knoweth the way that I take: when He hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

text: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
reflection: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.

text: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
reflection: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.

text: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
reflection: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

text: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
reflection: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

text: And Jesus said unto them, Because of your unbelief: for verily I say unto you, If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye shall say unto this mountain, Remove hence to yonder place; and it shall remove; and nothing shall be impossible unto you.
reflection: If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed, nothing shall be impossible unto you.

text: But Jesus beheld them , and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
reflection: With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.

text: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
reflection: All things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.

text: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world. Amen.
reflection: Lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world.

text: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.
reflection: If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.

text: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.
reflection: With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.

text: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them , and ye shall have them .
reflection: What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.

text: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
reflection: For with God nothing shall be impossible.

text: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.
reflection: Blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.

text: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
reflection: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

text: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.
reflection: The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

text: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.
reflection: I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

text: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
reflection: Whatsoever ye shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

text: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
reflection: If thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised Him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.

text: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
reflection: Whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.

text: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord’s.
reflection: Whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's.

text: God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of his Son Jesus Christ our Lord.
reflection: God is faithful, by whom ye were called unto the fellowship of His Son Jesus Christ our Lord.

text: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
reflection: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.

text: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
reflection: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; love abides forever.

text: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
reflection: Now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.

text: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
reflection: Be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.

text: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
reflection: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;

text: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
reflection: We look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are not seen are eternal.

text: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
reflection: Let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

text: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.
reflection: We are His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them.

text: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
reflection: Now unto Him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,

text: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
reflection: Being confident of this very thing, that He which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:

text: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do , forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
reflection: Forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,

text: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
reflection: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

text: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.
reflection: Faithful is He that calleth you, who also will do it.

text: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
reflection: If we believe not, yet He abideth faithful: He cannot deny Himself.

text: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
reflection: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; for He is faithful that promised;

text: But without faith it is impossible to please him : for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
reflection: He that cometh to God must believe that He is, and that He is a rewarder of them that diligently seek Him.

text: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us , and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
reflection: Let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

text: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
reflection: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before Him endured the cross.

text: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
reflection: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

text: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
reflection: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life.

text: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
reflection: Draw nigh to God, and He will draw nigh to you.

text: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
reflection: Sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you.

text: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you .
reflection: The God of all grace, who hath called us unto His eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.

text: The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
reflection: The Lord is not slack concerning His promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish.

text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
reflection: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

text: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
reflection: This is the confidence that we have in Him, that, if we ask any thing according to His will, He heareth us:

text: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
reflection: Unto Him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of His glory with exceeding joy,

text: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
reflection: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.

text: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.
reflection: Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

text: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.
reflection: He that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And He said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.

text: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
reflection: Let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.

text: For thou, LORD , wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.
reflection: God crowns the faithful with unmerited favor, surrounding them like a mighty shield.

text: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
reflection: Goodness and mercy follow you every day of your life as you dwell in God's presence.

text: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!
reflection: How great is God's goodness, laid up in store for those who revere Him!

text: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.
reflection: Taste and see that the Lord is good; blessed is the person who trusts in Him.

text: Thy mercy, O LORD , is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.
reflection: God's mercy reaches into the heavens, and His faithfulness towers to the clouds.

text: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.
reflection: I will hope continually and praise You more and more as each day unfolds.

text: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
reflection: The Lord God is a sun and shield; no good thing will He withhold from the upright.

text: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.
reflection: The Lord is good and ready to forgive, plenteous in mercy to all who call on Him.

text: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.
reflection: For the Lord is good; His mercy is everlasting, and His truth endureth to all generations.

text: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
reflection: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies.

text: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.
reflection: As the heaven is high above the earth, so great is His mercy toward them that fear Him.

text: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
reflection: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath He removed our transgressions from us.
